title: OpenMana local data
description: Everything OpenMana keeps in the browser's IndexedDB (one record type per object store) and the backup file format. The only source of the record types and validators in src/storage/generated (scripts/generate-storage.ts). Every record is plain JSON, so it survives a backup unchanged.

SchemaVersion.title: SchemaVersion
SchemaVersion.description: Version of the record schemas below = version of the IndexedDB database. Every change to a record shape or to the stores raises it and adds a migration (src/storage/migrations.ts) that upgrades the database and older backups alike. It is also the version of the collection the ORYX cloud keeps (CollectionDocument).

BackupFormatVersion.title: BackupFormatVersion
BackupFormatVersion.description: Version of the backup container (header, record and end lines). Independent of the record schemas, which the header names by SchemaVersion.

Timestamp.title: Timestamp
Timestamp.description: A point in time in UTC as Date.prototype.toISOString() writes it; sorts correctly as text.

Uuid.title: Uuid
Uuid.description: A UUID in lower case (crypto.randomUUID(), Scryfall ids).

AppVersion.title: AppVersion
AppVersion.description: The OpenMana build that wrote something: its version and Git commit (null if the build did not know it).

DeckFormat.title: DeckFormat
DeckFormat.description: How Forge plays the deck (the protocol's MatchFormat). Not a legality claim: Forge decides.

DeckCard.title: DeckCard
DeckCard.description: One normalized deck entry. name: the English card name Forge knows (front face of a double-faced card). set/collectorNumber: the printing the import named, if any - set is Scryfall's set code (lower case; the import maps MTG Arena's codes such as DAR to it). oracleId/scryfallId: Scryfall identities once resolved (display only, never rules); none for cards only Forge knows.

DeckSource.title: DeckSource
DeckSource.description: Where the deck came from: the original import text, unchanged.

DeckRecord.title: DeckRecord
DeckRecord.description: Store decks (key: id). A deck of the local library.

companion.description: The companion the list names (MTG Arena's Companion section; schema version 3). It plays from the sideboard, where Forge looks for it, so it is in the sideboard as well; this names which card it is. Absent: none known (decks saved before schema version 3 did not record it).

DeckTombstoneRecord.title: DeckTombstoneRecord
DeckTombstoneRecord.description: Store deckTombstones (key: id; schema version 4). A deletion mark: the deck with this id was deleted at deletedAt - on this device (deleteDeck writes it) or on another device of the player (it came with the collection of the ORYX cloud). It keeps the merge of two collections from bringing the deck back; a deck changed after deletedAt wins over it (src/storage/collection.ts). Kept 90 days; stays in this browser and in the synced collection, never in a backup.

SettingKey.title: SettingKey
SettingKey.description: Dotted lower camel case, e.g. ai.profile.

SettingRecord.title: SettingRecord
SettingRecord.description: Store settings (key: key). One preference. The value is checked by the setting's definition in src/storage/settings.ts; keys this app version does not know are kept as they are.

MatchStatus.title: MatchStatus
MatchStatus.description: running: recording (or interrupted, if the app closed meanwhile); finished: Forge ended the game; aborted: the engine stopped technically.

GameResult.title: GameResult
GameResult.description: From the player's point of view (the protocol's GameResult).

MatchDeck.title: MatchDeck
MatchDeck.description: A deck exactly as it was handed to Forge (the protocol's Deck), kept with the match: the library deck may change or disappear later.

deckId.description: The library deck it came from, if any.

MatchEngine.title: MatchEngine
MatchEngine.description: The engine that played the match: its content address (/engine/<id>/), protocol and Forge build.

manifestSha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact engine manifest bytes. Absent in recordings before schema version 5.

MatchEnd.title: MatchEnd
MatchEnd.description: Forge's game.end, as far as the match library shows it.

MatchRecord.title: MatchRecord
MatchRecord.description: Store matches (key: id, index startedAt). The header of a recorded match; its protocol transcript is in matchLog. Recording starts with prompt 22, which may refine this shape through a migration.

seed.description: The random seed handed to Forge, if one was fixed.

MatchLogEntry.title: MatchLogEntry
MatchLogEntry.description: Store matchLog (key: [matchId, seq]). One protocol message of a recorded match, in order: what the engine sent (questions, states, events, game end) and what the player sent (answers, taps). The message is kept as the protocol version of its match defined it and is not checked against today's protocol.

ColorLetters.title: ColorLetters
ColorLetters.description: Colours as letters in WUBRG order; empty = colourless.

LanguageCode.title: LanguageCode
LanguageCode.description: Scryfall's language code of a printing (en, de, ja …).

ImageStatus.title: ImageStatus
ImageStatus.description: Scryfall's image_status of a printing. Only lowres and highres_scan are real pictures of the card; placeholder is a stand-in Scryfall shows until it has a scan, missing means no picture at all.

PrintRef.title: PrintRef
PrintRef.description: One printing of a card as far as display needs it. The picture URLs are not stored: they follow from id, side and imageVersion (src/cards/images.ts; the catalog build checks every URL of the catalog against that rule). imageSides: 0 no picture, 1 one picture (front), 2 front and back (double-faced cards).

imageVersion.description: Scryfall's image timestamp (the query of its image URLs); present when imageSides > 0.

CardFace.title: CardFace
CardFace.description: One face of a card in English, as the Oracle has it today. Absent fields: the face has none (a land has no mana cost). colors: only on multi-face cards whose faces have colours of their own.

PrintedFace.title: PrintedFace
PrintedFace.description: What one face says in the language of a printing (Scryfall's printed_name, printed_type_line, printed_text). Absent fields were not printed or are unknown to Scryfall; the English face stands in for them.

PrintedText.title: PrintedText
PrintedText.description: A card's printed text in one language, per face in the order of the card's faces, from the printing named here. A translation of the Oracle text of its day: it does not receive errata.

CardAlias.title: CardAlias
CardAlias.description: Another English name printed on some printings of a card (Universes Beyond names, flavour names) and the printing that shows it.

CardRecord.title: CardRecord
CardRecord.description: Store scryfallCards (key: oracleId; index nameKeys, multi-entry). One card (one Oracle identity) of the card catalog: English faces, the German printed text, the default printings to show, and the names of the Forge cards that are this card. For display, search and import lookups only - never for rules, which Forge alone decides. Derived data from the card catalog (cards/): never backed up, replaced as a whole when the app brings a new catalog.

oracleId.description: Scryfall's Oracle id: the same for every printing of the card.

name.description: The English Oracle name; "Front // Back" for cards with several faces.

layout.description: Scryfall's layout (normal, split, flip, transform, modal_dfc, meld, adventure, token …).

faces.description: One face for single-faced cards, else Scryfall's faces in order.

colors.description: The card's colours; for a double-faced card without colours of its own those of its front face.

forgeNames.description: The names of the Forge cards that are this card, as Forge's deck lists and protocol use them (usually one); empty: the engine does not know it.

nameKeys.description: Normalized names (src/cards/names.ts) the card is found by: English name and face names, English names of printings and aliases, German printed names.

de.description: The German printed text; null: Scryfall knows no German printing with text.

prints.description: The printings shown by default. de: the best German printing with a real picture (null: none). fallback: the best English printing, or one in the card's only language.

PrintRecord.title: PrintRecord
PrintRecord.description: Store scryfallPrints (key: id; indexes print [set, collectorNumber, lang], oracleId). One particular printing, fetched from Scryfall's API when a deck names it (set and collector number) and the catalog does not carry it. Derived data: never backed up; fetchedAt decides when it is fetched again.

printed.description: The printed text per face, for printings not in English.

SetRecord.title: SetRecord
SetRecord.description: Store scryfallSets (key: code; indexes arenaCode, forgeCodes (multi-entry)). A Magic set as Scryfall lists it, with the codes MTG Arena and Forge use for it.

arenaCode.description: The set code MTG Arena uses (deck exports), if it differs or exists.

forgeCodes.description: Forge edition codes whose cards are this set (Forge's ScryfallCode).

ForgeOnlyReason.title: ForgeOnlyReason
ForgeOnlyReason.description: Why a Forge card has no Scryfall data. rebalanced: an MTG Arena rebalanced card (A-), which Scryfall does not list; listed: named in cards/forge-unmatched.json with a note.

ForgeOnlyCardRecord.title: ForgeOnlyCardRecord
ForgeOnlyCardRecord.description: Store forgeOnlyCards (key: name; index nameKeys, multi-entry). A card the engine knows but the card catalog has no Scryfall data for: it stays playable and is shown with Forge's own texts.

CacheStatus.title: CacheStatus
CacheStatus.description: partial: being stored (or interrupted); complete: usable.

CacheEntryRecord.title: CacheEntryRecord
CacheEntryRecord.description: Store cacheIndex (key: key; indexes kind, lastUsedAt). Bookkeeping of one cached resource (the card catalog, later card images in Cache Storage …): where from, which version, complete or not, size, last use. Derived data: never backed up.

DatabaseMeta.title: DatabaseMeta
DatabaseMeta.description: Store meta, key database: the database's own history, written by every upgrade. createdAt/createdBy are null if the record had to be written anew.

ImportMode.title: ImportMode
ImportMode.description: merge: add what is new, the newer of two copies wins, nothing is deleted; replace: the stores of the backup are emptied first.

BackupMeta.title: BackupMeta
BackupMeta.description: Store meta, key backup: when this browser last made or loaded a backup (the app reminds of backups with it).

MetaRecord.title: MetaRecord
MetaRecord.description: Store meta (key: key). Metadata of this database; stays in this browser and is not part of backups.

BackupStore.title: BackupStore
BackupStore.description: The stores a backup holds: the user's own data. Caches (scryfallCards, scryfallPrints, scryfallSets, forgeOnlyCards, cacheIndex) and meta are never part of a backup.

BackupHeader.title: BackupHeader
BackupHeader.description: First line of a backup file. stores: the stores this backup holds, in file order; replacing restores exactly these.

BackupRecordLine.title: BackupRecordLine
BackupRecordLine.description: One record of a store, as the header's schemaVersion defined it.

BackupEnd.title: BackupEnd
BackupEnd.description: Last line of a backup file: how many records each store has. A file without it, or with other counts, is incomplete.

CollectionDocument.title: CollectionDocument
CollectionDocument.description: The player's collection as one JSON document: what the ORYX cloud keeps in its slot 'collection' (src/cloud; built, checked, merged and applied by src/storage/collection.ts). Like the lines of a backup, its records are those of its own schemaVersion and are checked one by one after the database's own migrations upgraded them. decks: every valid deck; deckTombstones: the deletion marks; settings: the preferences shared between the player's devices - every setting except display.*, which belong to the device. Never caches (card catalog, printings, engine), recorded matches or the database's metadata. Sorted by id and key, so equal content gives equal JSON.

schemaVersion.description: The local data schema version its records follow (4: the first synced one).

CatalogFormatVersion.title: CatalogFormatVersion
CatalogFormatVersion.description: Version of the card catalog container (header, record lines, end line). Its records are those of the header's schemaVersion.

CatalogSource.title: CatalogSource
CatalogSource.description: The Scryfall data a card catalog was made from: the bulk file (as Scryfall published it) and the set list.

updatedAt.description: When Scryfall made the bulk file.

CatalogForge.title: CatalogForge
CatalogForge.description: The Forge card database the catalog was matched against (the engine's pinned Forge): how many cards it has, how many the catalog found, how many have no Scryfall data.

CatalogHeader.title: CatalogHeader
CatalogHeader.description: First line of a card catalog file (cards/build/dist, made by cards/scripts/build-catalog.ts).

schemaVersion.description: The local data schema version its records follow.

CatalogLine.title: CatalogLine
CatalogLine.description: A record line of a card catalog file: a card, a set or a Forge card without Scryfall data.

CatalogEnd.title: CatalogEnd
CatalogEnd.description: Last line of a card catalog file: how many lines of each kind came before. A file without it, or with other counts, is incomplete.

ReplayDocument.title: ReplayDocument
ReplayDocument.description: Portable snapshot recording. Versions belong to the recorded match; schemaVersion names the record shapes.
